links.outcome: Chatbot predicted survival versus real-world survival in HCC patients
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o consistently overestimated overall survival compared with real-world outcomes; significant discrepancy between predicted and actual survival (p < 0.05), especially in early-stage HCC.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o consistently overestimated the overall survival (OS) times compared to real-world outcomes.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of ChatGPT-4o's ability to predict survival times for hepatocellular carcinoma patients compared to real-world outcomes; evaluates baseline model accuracy without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
